title: BFF-ADM-016 current BFF administration through actual UI

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Tile fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And Category 101 has label "category-a" and Import Map 201 has Module Name "container-a"
4. And both references belong to "FMO_ADMIN" and the Tile page category filter value is Category 101
5. And the Tile grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
6. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Name" as "tile-016"
7. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Path" as "/fixture"
8. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Path" as "/case-016"
9. And the baseline fixture data defines "Role Entities" as "E-TRADE"
10. And the baseline fixture data defines "Filter Rule" as ""
11. And the baseline Tile references use "Aplication Category" "category-a" and "Container" "container-a"
12. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Tile grid row with "Record Id" "101"
13. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" is visible on the Tile administration page
14. When Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Name" with "tile-016" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
15. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Path" with "/fixture" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
16. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Path" with "" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
17. And Admin A fills the textarea labeled "Role Entities" with "E-TRADE" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
18. And Admin A fills the textarea labeled "Filter Rule" with "" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
19. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
20. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" remains visible on the Tile administration page
21. And the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "Please provide the value for the Title or Module Path or Tile Path."
22. And the Tile data grid with column "Record Id" row identifiers and loaded field values equal the initial grid snapshot on the Tile administration page

annotations.description: Actual current React and exact-current BFF admin controllers/services/JPA with actual migration DDL in disposable PostgreSQL. Controlled OUD/EMS2 identities and local Spring bootstrap. Fixture SQL seeds/mutates isolated records; service errors are actual database errors. Undefined agreed messages remain unresolved acceptance.
